### **Job Description and Duties**


Do you aspire to work towards protecting our population and the environment from harmful chemicals? Then consider joining the Department of Toxic Substances Control (DTSC), Safer Consumer Products (SCP) Program. Our team is a dynamic, passionate, and diverse group of scientists, engineers, toxicologists, analysts, and administrative staff working to protect California's people and the environment by advancing the design, development, and use of chemically safer products. SCP is seeking an Environmental Scientist to help implement laws banning certain chemicals in consumer products, including developing regulations and conducting compliance and enforcement activities. This position is under the general direction of a Senior Environmental Scientist (Supervisory). Learn more by visiting our homepage at https://www.dtsc.ca.gov/SCP/.  

**As an Environmental Scientist you will have the opportunity to:**
* Conduct technical research and data analysis to support the development of regulations, compliance sampling plans, and enforcement strategies, including identifying manufacturers and evaluating covered products to understand the scope of regulated products sold in California
* Assist with drafting rulemaking packages and preparing documentation to implement statutory and regulatory requirements in compliance with the Administrative Procedures Act
* Assist with pre\-regulatory workshops, public meetings, and external engagement activities, including outreach to manufacturers, retailers, and other interested parties
* Support the procurement and cataloging of samples for laboratory testing to carry out compliance sampling plans
* Analyze testing results and review documents submitted by responsible entities to assess compliance with chemical bans
* Provide technical assistance and compliance support to responsible entities, including manufacturers and retailers
* Help prepare public\-facing resources such as guidance documents, fact sheets, and website content to keep interested parties informed of compliance requirements and enforcement actions
* Assist with compliance and enforcement activities, including conducting investigations, preparing notices of violation, and developing documentation to support enforcement actions
* Draft reports to inform the Legislature, the public, department leadership, and agency management of compliance and enforcement updates

**Desirable Qualifications We Look For:**
* Ability to contribute to a team environment that values the diverse areas of experience and expertise of program staff
* Technical/Environmental Health writing \& editing experience
* Ability to identify a challenging problem and formulate and execute a solution
* Can complete long\-term projects
* Has ability to analyze and work with large volumes of data and information
* Ability to focus on maintaining professional, productive relationships with their peers, management, and external partners
* Knowledge of or experience with products, chemicals in products, or supply chains
* Strong communication skills, including editing, writing, and presenting
* Ability to maintain a well\-organized and flexible approach appropriate for working in a dynamic environment

Are you interested in a meaningful and impactful career? Would you like to contribute to protecting people and the environment and accelerating a statewide transition to sustainable pest management? The Department of Pesticide Regulation (DPR) could be the place for you!
  

  

Under the direction of the Environmental Program Manager I (Supervisory), the Senior Environmental Scientist (Specialist) acts as the scientific expert on the protection of surface water from pesticide contamination. The Senior Environmental Scientist (Specialist) independently identifies problems, develops courses of action, and conducts complex scientific investigations and studies. The incumbent may help lead or coordinate specific monitoring efforts for the Surface Water Protection Program and act as a subject matter expert analyzing monitoring and environmental data to support DPR's continuous evaluation and mitigation efforts.
  

  

Specific responsibilities include:


* Conceives, proposes, plans, organizes, and directs complex surface water protection tasks, including primary and lead responsibility on scientific and technical evaluation of pesticide impacts to surface water.
* Independently conceives plans and implements complex studies to assess the spatial and temporal distributions of pesticide detections (and associated toxicity and aquatic macro\-invertebrate impairment) in surface water and sediment.
* Provides quality assurance and quality control of monitoring methods, analytical methods and monitoring data. Gathers, manages, assesses, and interprets monitoring and environmental data using a variety of tools and techniques including statistics, programming language (e.g., SQL, R, Python), geographic information systems (GIS), databases (e.g., MS Access), and/or other computer modeling in support of Surface Water's monitoring and mitigation efforts. Designs or defines needed equipment and instrumentation required for research, or develops new research methods to solve the most difficult surface water monitoring needs.
* Coordinates with state and federal pesticide and water quality agencies on scientific and regulatory projects of shared interest; consults with agencies, universities, growers, registrants, County Agricultural Commissioners, and stakeholders on complex monitoring and mitigation studies and other ecological health projects. Interacts with an interdisciplinary team of scientists.
* Writes reports, documents and technical publications, and makes oral presentations to governmental entities, professional societies, stakeholders, or pesticide user groups. Serves as technical advisor for programmatic or project needs.
* Performs critical review of data and proposed projects submitted by registrants, CDPR staff, and other agencies for scientific integrity and application to program objectives.

When respiratory protective equipment is required, the employee must adhere to the fitting requirements stated in DPR’s respiratory protection policy.

jobs.description:
Summit Engineering, Inc. is seeking a highly motivated Water Wastewater Project Engineer or Geologist with Hydrogeology experience to join our dynamic team. This role is focused on groundwater supply, water availability, and water adequacy evaluations for water supply systems and infrastructure projects. The ideal candidate will have experience evaluating whether existing or proposed groundwater sources can reliably meet current and future water demands, including review of well records, aquifer testing, pumping data, modeling, seasonal groundwater trends, water quality and applicable County or regulatory requirements. The ideal candidate is self\-directed, technically strong and capable of managing complex hydrogeologic and engineering tasks while contributing to client relationships and business development.

Onsite (Santa Rosa) or Remote (depending upon experience)

**Salary Range:** $95,000 to $160,000 annually

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

**Hydrogeology \& Water Resources Experience**

* Plan, facilitate and execute groundwater investigations, including desktop studies, aquifer testing data interpretation
* Design, oversee and analyze aquifer tests (pumping, step\-drawdown, slug tests) to estimate aquifer parameters
* Evaluate site geology and regional geologic setting to understand how subsurface conditions may influence groundwater occurrence, aquifer behavior, recharge potential, storage, flow direction, water quality, well performance, and project feasibility
* Prepare and support groundwater source adequacy, water availability, and well capacity evaluations for development projects
* Review and interpret well completion reports, driller’s logs, geologic maps, boring logs, pump test data, static and pumping water levels, well production records, and available local groundwater data
* Develop or review water demand estimates and compare existing/proposed demands to available water supply data
* Plan, oversee, and interpret aquifer and well performance testing, including pumping tests, step\-drawdown tests, slug tests, and water level monitoring
* Evaluate seasonal reliability, dry\-year performance, well interference potential, and limitations of existing or proposed groundwater sources
* Analyze hydrogeologic data using appropriate tools, including conceptual hydrogeologic models and, where applicable, numerical groundwater modeling
* Prepare technical memoranda, water availability evaluations, and client and agency\-facing summaries that clearly communicate assumptions, limitations, risks, and recommended next steps
* Coordinate with regulatory agencies, well drillers, pump contractors, laboratories, and design teams as needed
* Analyze hydrogeologic data using appropriate tools
* Collect groundwater quality samples, coordinate lab analysis and interpret geochemical data
* Support conceptual and numerical groundwater modeling

**Engineering \& Project Delivery**

* Develop fee and time estimates for proposal preparation
* Communicate project status and updates to Project Managers
* Identify scope changes and alert Project Managers accordingly
* Prepare engineering analysis, calculations, and designs for assigned project components
* Produce construction documents with minimal oversight
* Manage task assignments to meet project budget and timelines
* Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance
* Stay current with industry codes and standards
* Respond to RFIs, review submittals and perform site visits
* Collaborate with clients and consultants for data collection and coordination
* Act as a technical lead on multi\-disciplinary tasks as needed

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Hydrogeology, Geology, Civil/Environmental Engineering or related field
* Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in the field of hydrogeology, groundwater resources, or environmental consulting
* California Professional Engineer (PE) license or Professional Geologist (PG) preferred or in the process of obtaining
* Familiarity with multiple hydrogeologic settings (unconsolidated, consolidated and bedrock aquifers)
* Experience with groundwater modeling software (e.g. MODFLOW, SWMM or similar tools)
* Proficiency in engineering and design software such as AutoCAD, Civil 3D, and Bluebeam
* Strong communication, organization, time management and problem\-solving skills with the ability to support multiple projects
* Understanding of applicable codes, permitting processes, and engineering design principles
* Must maintain a valid Driver’s License
* Eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship

We love making games. Been making ‘em since 1992, together since 2009\.


Founder \& CEO Bob Rafei fell in love with original IP development in ‘94 at Naughty Dog during early days on Crash Bandicoot series. CTO Jeff Lander has been programming and leading tech teams developing game engine and systems since ‘92\. Together they founded BRB with the mission of using Unreal and Unity game engines to streamline production in order to find the fun, fast.


This effective approach has since produced original titles and prototypes with previous partners such as; *Sega, Niantic Labs, Google, EA, Lionsgate, Starbreeze, Sony, NBC Universal, Mobilityware, Fox Next, and Bethesda Game Studios*.


  
PROJECT TAPESTRY


Any GAME, Any STYLE, ANYWHERE


BRB’s proprietary tools for bringing world\-class IPs to real\-world mobile gaming. Combining BRB’s unique Geospatial expertise with decades of game development experience to create an advanced technology platform converging latest in geo\-location, wearables, AR and Computer Vision technologies for Casual \& Core games or E\-Commerce apps.


Tapestry is engine agnostic and able to run on any platform. Tapestry allows BRB clients and partners to quickly create scalable social worlds where one or many players can impact the game’s persistent global play arena through their local gameplay.


Contact us for demos and more info: tapestry@brbent.com


  
### **Overview**


Big Red Button is composed of industry veteran game developers focused on delivering authentic gaming experiences that are as fun to watch as they are to play.


Our studio in Southern California is seeking up\-and\-coming staffers to work on an “unannounced” project.


  
Senior Mobile Data Analyst/Scientist


Big Red Button (BRB) is a collection of game industry veterans coming together to make fun and unique games we’d personally like to play on new and established platforms.


A BRB career is about moving fast with a small, focused and experienced indie team finding solutions to unique technical, gameplay and visual problems.


We are looking for an experienced data analyst or scientist to interpret data from franchises like Fallout or Oblivion, and make recommendations, plan and lead the dev team in implementing adjustments improving player acquisition, retention and monetization. Our ideal candidate has prior experience analyzing data from mobile games. If you’re an economist steeped in RPG monetization structures, we’re looking for you!


This position will indefinitely work remotely.


Responsibilities:
* Work as the main point of contact for analytics of one of the top video game franchises of all time, adapted to mobile.
* Work closely with the game team to identify, develop, and provide analytical answers to challenges they face.
* Design interactive and real\-time dashboards and provide data\-informed insights to recommend features optimization after release \& features implementation on a liveops game.
* Prepare and present analyses in an oral and/or written format to the game team.
* Write queries to import, manipulate, clean, and transform data from different sources.
* Creating and managing multiple A/B tests to gain valuable insights on KPIs including retention, acquisition, and monetization.
* Work with different teams to adapt approaches and tools to solve complex problems and find good balance between velocity, accuracy, and quality.

Requirements:
* BS in Computer Science, Math, Statistics, Economics, or other quantitative field
* 3\+ years, minimally 1 year, of work experience in games analytics roles, building dashboards, developing data models and visualization dashboards.
* Proficiency in SQL (Kusto is a plus)
* Excellent data visualization skills (Power BI is a plus)
* Autonomy and excellent organization skills
* Strong written and oral communication skills
* Passion for games

Qualifying candidates should expect to go through a technical interview process.


Big Red Button offers competitive salaries and benefits. We’re committed to achieving a diverse workforce. Qualified candidates from all walks of life irrespective of race, color, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, and disability are encouraged to apply.
